Title: [LSJ] Priscus vote to burn a Fee Stake

Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:

<news:366bfade.0107091855.3d688691@posting.google.com>...

> > > >(b) All Prisci cast 1 fewer vote during the Prisci sub-vote; the Prisci
> > > >abstain unless Gratiano is out, and the Prisci block is worth 3 votes
> > > >as normal.

> > > This is correct, so far as I can tell.

> > Correct. The title "Priscus" is worth 1 vote in the Priscus
> > sub-referendum.
> > It is worth 1 less vote in that sub-referendum during the Free States
> > Rant.

> Just curious - I don't mean to be annoying:

> How many votes does Genevieve have during a Free States Rant?
> (0 of each?)

The title is worth 1 less. Nothing is said about the special ability.
So she has 1 in the main referendum (special ability), and zero in
the Prisci sub-referendum.

> How many votes does a Regent have during a Free States Rant?
> (3?)

Yes.
